title: Professional Email Term Renewal Amount
content:
Billing calculation sheet for the term renewal of an active Professional Email subscription.

The term renewal is the rounded renewal component plus every fee added to it, rounded half up to the cent. The renewal component is the renewed seats times the plan seat price times the renewal months, reduced by any rate that applies to it, rounded half up to the cent. The plan seat price is the product's annual-prepaid seat price, its annual-commitment price. The renewal months are the calendar months from the term start date to the term end date on the annual prepaid and monthly plans, and 1 on the annual-billed-monthly plan, whose term renewal is the new term's first monthly instalment. The renewed seats are the seat count on the subscription. No fee is added.

## Inputs

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Annual-prepaid seat price | the product's price schedule |
| Billing plan, term start and end dates | the subscription record |
| Seat count | the subscription record |

## Worked examples (hypothetical price and seats)

| Billing plan | Term | Seat count | Hypothetical annual-commitment seat price | Renewal months | Term renewal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| annual prepaid | 12 calendar months | 23 | 9.00 | 12 | 2484.00 |
| monthly | 1 calendar month | 23 | 9.00 | 1 | 207.00 |
| annual billed monthly | 12 calendar months | 23 | 9.00 | 1 | 207.00 |
